parse_base_options: parse command line arguments for the omnimatte model training or testing configuration
gather_options_with_model: gather command line options including model-specific and dataset-specific arguments from argv
initialize_parser_arguments: initialize an argparse parser with common training and test options like dataroot and gpu_ids
print_and_save_options: print parsed options to console and save them to a text file in the checkpoints directory
set_gpu_device: set the active CUDA GPU device based on the gpu_ids command line argument
